### Beauty is...

**A JOURNEY OF TRANSFORMATION**
**A JOURNEY OF TRANSFORMATION**

“La Fabbrica per l’Uomo” is a book telling the fascinating story of how an Olivetti typewriter
factory, left abandoned for decades, was brought to new life thanks to the booming industry of
made-in-Italy cosmetics. A symbol of the industrial past of our hometown, this manufacturing plant
now stands as a landmark of beauty and innovation. The restoration project embodies our company’s
commitment to a zero-land-consumption philosophy. To celebrate this transformation, we are releasing
a series of interviews featuring former Olivetti managers who once worked there, sharing their
memories and experiences.

[WATCH THE TRAILER][14]
**FROM VALUE CHAIN TO CHAIN OF VALUES**
**FROM VALUE CHAIN TO CHAIN OF VALUES**

In 2021, we joined GoGreen Climate Neutral, enabling us to calculate and offset the carbon dioxide
emissions generated by our logistics operations with DHL by financing internationally recognized
climate protection projects. Just last year, we successfully neutralized 70,994.28 kg of CO2e. Even
though carbon offsetting has a positive impact on the environment, it does not directly minimize the
carbon footprint of the transport sector. This is why, starting this year, we have embarked on a new
path towards sustainability through insetting. Thanks to DHL GoGreen Plus, we are actively reducing
carbon emissions with investments in sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).

[LEARN MORE][15]
**WELL-BEING AND SELF-CARE**
**WELL-BEING AND SELF-CARE**

La forza e il sorriso – Look Good Feel Better Italia Onlus organizes free beauty workshops for women
facing cancer. Sponsored by Cosmetica Italia — the Italian personal care association — this
non-profit organization’s mission is helping women cope with the appearance-related side effects of
medical treatment to rebuild their femininity and self-confidence.
We have been supporting them since 2018.
La forza e il sorriso Onlus currently counts 29 corporate partners and more than 50 host structures.
It has assisted 18.500 women over its 15-year activity.

[LEARN MORE][16]
**GIVING BACK TO THE LOCAL COMMUNITY**
**GIVING BACK TO THE LOCAL COMMUNITY**

We take pride in being a founding member of the San Domenico Foundation, encompassing the local
theater, a music institute, and a gallery of modern and contemporary art. We wholeheartedly believe
in the Foundation’s mission to foster culture as a catalyst for social engagement and socio-cultural
development in the town of Crema and the broader territory. By supporting the practice, teaching,
dissemination, and promotion of artistic activities, we fulfill our commitment to the cultural
enrichment of our community.

[LEARN MORE][17]
**LOVE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT**
**LOVE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT**

Through the consistent implementation of structural enhancements, machinery upgrades, and process
improvements in our production facility, we steadily enhance our environmental performance.
Since 2020, we have been exclusively using electricity from renewable resources. As for waste
management, we are currently collaborating on an experimental project aimed at exploring alternative
methods for the disposal of waste from the cosmetic industry: we see a bright future!

[LEARN MORE][18]
**RESPECTING THE EXISTING**
**RESPECTING THE EXISTING**

Thanks to the acquisition of a former Olivetti typewriter factory, we were able to expand our
facilities without consuming additional land, giving new life to an industrial site that would have
otherwise faced complete and irreversible decline. The building, originally designed in the 1960s by
the globally renowned architect Marco Zanuso, also saw the early contributions of a young Renzo
Piano. Our commitment to local heritage inspired us to open an exhibition space dedicated to
typewriters within our facility.

[LEARN MORE][19]

though carbon offsetting has a positive impact on the environment, it does not directly minimize the
carbon footprint of the transport sector. This is why, starting this year, we have embarked on a new
path towards sustainability through insetting. Thanks to DHL GoGreen Plus, we are actively reducing
carbon emissions with investments in sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).

[LEARN MORE][15]
**WELL-BEING AND SELF-CARE**
**WELL-BEING AND SELF-CARE**

La forza e il sorriso – Look Good Feel Better Italia Onlus organizes free beauty workshops for women
facing cancer. Sponsored by Cosmetica Italia — the Italian personal care association — this
non-profit organization’s mission is helping women cope with the appearance-related side effects of
medical treatment to rebuild their femininity and self-confidence.
We have been supporting them since 2018.
La forza e il sorriso Onlus currently counts 29 corporate partners and more than 50 host structures.
It has assisted 18.500 women over its 15-year activity.

[LEARN MORE][16]
**GIVING BACK TO THE LOCAL COMMUNITY**
**GIVING BACK TO THE LOCAL COMMUNITY**

We take pride in being a founding member of the San Domenico Foundation, encompassing the local
theater, a music institute, and a gallery of modern and contemporary art. We wholeheartedly believe
in the Foundation’s mission to foster culture as a catalyst for social engagement and socio-cultural
development in the town of Crema and the broader territory. By supporting the practice, teaching,
dissemination, and promotion of artistic activities, we fulfill our commitment to the cultural
enrichment of our community.

[LEARN MORE][17]
**LOVE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT**
**LOVE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT**

Through the consistent implementation of structural enhancements, machinery upgrades, and process
improvements in our production facility, we steadily enhance our environmental performance.
Since 2020, we have been exclusively using electricity from renewable resources. As for waste
management, we are currently collaborating on an experimental project aimed at exploring alternative
methods for the disposal of waste from the cosmetic industry: we see a bright future!

[LEARN MORE][18]
**RESPECTING THE EXISTING**
**RESPECTING THE EXISTING**

Thanks to the acquisition of a former Olivetti typewriter factory, we were able to expand our
facilities without consuming additional land, giving new life to an industrial site that would have
otherwise faced complete and irreversible decline. The building, originally designed in the 1960s by
the globally renowned architect Marco Zanuso, also saw the early contributions of a young Renzo
Piano. Our commitment to local heritage inspired us to open an exhibition space dedicated to
typewriters within our facility.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about cosmetic manufacturing, custom formulations, packaging options,
and MOQ logistics.

### What are your minimum order quantities (MOQs)?

Our standard MOQ is 5,000 units for custom formulations and high-end private label packaging (such
as serums, face wash, or luxury jars). For basic packaging or stock formulas, we can occasionally
facilitate smaller runs of 3,000 units depending on the packaging type.

### Do you charge for formulation engineering and sampling?

We provide basic formulation matching and stock samples for qualified cosmetic businesses for free.
For highly complex custom cosmetic formulation development requiring clinical trials or special
sourcing, a standard R&D fee is charged, which is offset against the final production invoice.

### Are your cosmetic formulas cruelty-free and vegan?

Yes, all our formulas are 100% cruelty-free and we never test on animals. We offer certified vegan,
natural, organic, and Ayurvedic compliant options built with premium plant extracts.

### Do you provide regulatory support and MSDS certificates?

Absolutely. We provide comprehensive compliance support, including Certificate of Analysis (COA),
Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), stability and microbial testing reports, and support with FDA or
local AYUSH registrations.

### Can you work with custom packaging sourced by our brand?

Yes. While we offer full-service sourcing, you can also ship your own custom containers directly to
our Indore facility for filling, labeling, and sealing.

### What is your standard production lead time?

For repeat orders with stock formulations, our typical lead time is 3-4 weeks. For new custom
formulations, including stability testing and packaging sourcing, the initial timeline is typically
8-12 weeks.

### Do you offer drop-shipping or fulfillment services?

Currently, we focus exclusively on B2B manufacturing and do not offer direct-to-consumer fulfillment
or drop-shipping. We ship bulk pallets directly to your chosen warehouse or distribution center.

### Can you match a benchmark product formulation?

Yes, our R&D chemists specialize in reverse-engineering and matching benchmark products. Simply
provide us with a physical sample and the ingredient list, and we can develop a comparable or
superior formulation.

Beautyworld Dubai brings the global beauty supply chain together in the world's most connected trade
hub, Dubai. Every part of the beauty supply chain, fragrance, cosmetics, skincare, hair, beauty tech
and packaging, in one place, in one visit.

In just three days, you’ll discover what's next in beauty, build partnerships and drive business
growth.

Instead of months spent travelling, sourcing, comparing suppliers and chasing introductions, you'll
find the products and discover the insights that matter most in one powerful marketplace.

Register by **31 August** to secure your complimentary pass before **the USD 75 visitor fee starts
on 1 September.**

Miss it and you’re chasing it for the rest of the year.

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.

neck | 05/31/26]

### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.

### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.

### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.

Como fabricantes de cosméticos, creamos nuestros propios productos y **también los elaboramos para
terceros**. Como [distribuidores de cosméticos][86], somos proveedores líderes a nivel
internacional.

En CarasaLab, contamos con nuestro propio laboratorio y un departamento I+D con los más altos
estándares de producción. Nuestro laboratorio de cosméticos cuenta con **modernos equipamientos** y
un **equipo humano profesional y especializado**. Esto garantiza que la calidad de nuestros
productos sea inmejorable, sin olvidar el respeto por el medioambiente.

[Nuestro laboratorio de cosméticos][87]
[Especialistas en cosméticos a terceros (fabricación y distribución)]

## Expertos en cosméticos
## a terceros

En **CarasaLab** somos especialistas fabricantes de productos cosméticos a terceros. Trabajamos con
fabricantes o profesionales del sector que quieren lanzar al mercado nuevos productos con beneficios
innovadores, tanto para la piel como para el cabello.

Nos adaptamos a las necesidades de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo la combinación **calidad/precio
**requerida, desde los productos más básicos hasta los productos más sofisticados y con ingredientes
más innovadores del mercado. Con la confianza y respaldo de una fábrica de cosméticos comprometida
con resultados de máxima calidad.

## Fabricamos cosméticos
## naturales y ecológicos

Tratamos con **proveedores de materias primas ecológicas de la mejor calidad**, ya que son marcas
influyentes y con gran impacto a nivel mundial. Esto nos permite desarrollar fórmulas cosméticas en
perfecta armonía con la naturaleza y por tanto con mayores beneficios en su aplicación.

Nuestros [cosméticos para marcas propias][89] están elaborados bajo altos estándares de calidad
europeos. Además, cuidamos la salud de tus clientes y del planeta porque trabajamos con fabricantes

## Fabricamos cosméticos
## naturales y ecológicos

Tratamos con **proveedores de materias primas ecológicas de la mejor calidad**, ya que son marcas
influyentes y con gran impacto a nivel mundial. Esto nos permite desarrollar fórmulas cosméticas en

Ya seas una marca emergente que necesita cosmética a terceros en pocas unidades o una empresa
consolidada buscando un fabricante profesional certificado, en CarasaLab encontrarás el partner
ideal. Combinamos nuestra herencia de casi 100 años con tecnología de vanguardia para materializar
tu visión cosmética con las máximas garantías de calidad y cumplimiento normativo.

[Saber más][90]
[Elaboramos, fabricamos y distibuimos tintes capilares de alta calidad]

## Expertos en
## tintes profesionales

El** tinte capilar** es nuestro producto estrella en fabricación de cosméticos. En
**CarasaLab** fuimos pioneros en el **desarrollo de la coloración **tanto a nivel nacional como a
nivel internacional. Desde sus inicios en 1930, nuestro laboratorio ha trabajado para lograr la
combinación perfecta de ingredientes y procesos de elaboración.

Fabricamos tintes capilares de calidad que aportan **suavidad, durabilidad, cuidado y cobertura **al
cabello. Como fabricantes de cosmética especializados en coloración profesional, desarrollamos
fórmulas avanzadas que combinan eficacia cromática con respeto al cabello.

[Saber más][91]

**4ª Generación** de personas comprometidas

Más de **90 años** en el mercado cosmético

Fabricando para más de **60 marcas**

Exportando a más de **30 países**

**1000 Formulas** desarrolladas en nuestro laboratorio

## Fábrica de cosméticos de referencia en fórmulas de belleza y cuidado

El know-how adquirido a través de la experiencia y la formación continua de nuestro equipo nos
posiciona entre los fabricantes de cosmética referentes en España para marcas internacionales, con
capacidad de abordar proyectos también vinculados a la [peluquería profesional][92].

Como fabricante a terceros de productos cosméticos, tratamos de interiorizar el concepto de marca de
nuestro cliente y crear el cosmético que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades, tanto en el desarrollo
del producto como para ofrecer cosméticos a precio de fábrica, incluyendo líneas inspiradas en la
[cosmética coreana][93].

Trabajaremos juntos para definir primero el proyecto, elaborar las muestras que mejor se adapten a
vuestra solicitud y después realizar los trabajos administrativos regulados por la Unión Europea
para su venta.

Algo muy personal

Hazte una pregunta: ¿alguna vez le has regalado un cosmético a alguien? Si nos dices que “es algo
muy personal”, nosotros como expertos opinamos igual. Tu cabello, tu piel y tu rostro son únicos y
creemos que la fuerza está ahí, en la autenticidad, en ser diferentes. Por eso, nuestros productos
no son solo fórmulas, ingredientes y packs. Son productos personales, productos pensados para las
personas que van a utilizarlos. Porque como fabricantes de productos cosméticos profesionales, nos
gusta tratar la cosmética como lo que es: algo muy personal.

Tratamos con **proveedores de materias primas ecológicas de la mejor calidad**, ya que son marcas

[Saber más][90]
[Elaboramos, fabricamos y distibuimos tintes capilares de alta calidad]

## Expertos en
## tintes profesionales

El** tinte capilar** es nuestro producto estrella en fabricación de cosméticos. En
**CarasaLab** fuimos pioneros en el **desarrollo de la coloración **tanto a nivel nacional como a
nivel internacional. Desde sus inicios en 1930, nuestro laboratorio ha trabajado para lograr la
combinación perfecta de ingredientes y procesos de elaboración.

Fabricamos tintes capilares de calidad que aportan **suavidad, durabilidad, cuidado y cobertura **al
cabello. Como fabricantes de cosmética especializados en coloración profesional, desarrollamos
fórmulas avanzadas que combinan eficacia cromática con respeto al cabello.

[Saber más][91]

**4ª Generación** de personas comprometidas

Más de **90 años** en el mercado cosmético

Fabricando para más de **60 marcas**

Exportando a más de **30 países**

**1000 Formulas** desarrolladas en nuestro laboratorio

## Fábrica de cosméticos de referencia en fórmulas de belleza y cuidado

El know-how adquirido a través de la experiencia y la formación continua de nuestro equipo nos
posiciona entre los fabricantes de cosmética referentes en España para marcas internacionales, con
capacidad de abordar proyectos también vinculados a la [peluquería profesional][92].

Como fabricante a terceros de productos cosméticos, tratamos de interiorizar el concepto de marca de
nuestro cliente y crear el cosmético que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades, tanto en el desarrollo
del producto como para ofrecer cosméticos a precio de fábrica, incluyendo líneas inspiradas en la
[cosmética coreana][93].

Trabajaremos juntos para definir primero el proyecto, elaborar las muestras que mejor se adapten a
vuestra solicitud y después realizar los trabajos administrativos regulados por la Unión Europea
para su venta.

Algo muy personal

Hazte una pregunta: ¿alguna vez le has regalado un cosmético a alguien? Si nos dices que “es algo
muy personal”, nosotros como expertos opinamos igual. Tu cabello, tu piel y tu rostro son únicos y
creemos que la fuerza está ahí, en la autenticidad, en ser diferentes. Por eso, nuestros productos
no son solo fórmulas, ingredientes y packs. Son productos personales, productos pensados para las
personas que van a utilizarlos. Porque como fabricantes de productos cosméticos profesionales, nos
gusta tratar la cosmética como lo que es: algo muy personal.

## Expert Turnkey Contract Manufacturer
## of Cosmetics and Skin Care since 1988

Classic Cosmetics is a well-known leader in turnkey contract manufacturing of high-quality color
cosmetics and skin care products. We service a wide variety of clients ranging from large global and
domestic brands to “direct to consumer” and influencer labels. Our family owned company has been
developing cutting-edge formulas that have led the way in this industry since 1988. From concept to
launch, we partner with our clients to provide outstanding customer service at every turn. We are
certified to ISO 22716:2007-2008 European standards and have the expertise and capacity to meet your
needs. Classic Cosmetics is an audited and approved Global Supply Chain partner for many of the
world’s largest beauty brands. Whether you are large or small, starting a new brand, or managing an
existing brand, our team of dedicated professionals are ready to exceed your expectations for
service and quality. [Email or Call us][15] to find out how we can be your partner in success.

## Quality

Our job is to make sure that our clients are successful. That means we provide full support from the
time we start development until we ship your order. Our cGMP certification to European ISO 22716
means that every department is trained to serve our clients’ needs from start to finish. Our goal is
to not only deliver formulas that function as expected, but also address trending needs in the
marketplace. We want to help you lead the way, not follow what others have already done.
[home-featured-quality]
[home-featured-customer-service]

## Customer Service

Good customer service typically means providing timely, attentive, upbeat service to a customer, and
making sure their needs are met in a manner that reflects positively on the company. But we want to
do more than that. We want to be a valuable member of your supply chain and help you demonstrate
confidence and reliability to your clients. As your contract manufacturer, we consider it a
privilege to work tirelessly behind the scenes to make you shine.

## Corporate, Environmental and Social Responsibility

We are one of the first Contract Manufacturers to have become a Supply Chain Partner of the
Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO). Whether you are looking for recycled, upcycled,
recyclable or compostable, we will find the right raw material and packaging that meets your needs.

## Custom & Wholesale Cosmetic Jars Products

Our business encompasses the customization and wholesale distribution of excellent products such as
Acrylic Cosmetic Jars, Glass Cosmetic Jars, Plastic Cosmetic Jars, and Aluminum Cosmetic Jars.

## Our Business & Service

#### Transparency

Clear or transparent jars showcase product colors, textures, and usage levels, enhancing product
presentation and meeting customer needs.

#### Customizability

Cosmetic jars allow for customizable designs, labels, and closures, offering branding opportunities
and catering to specific product needs.

#### Preservation

They provide a secure and sealed storage environment, protecting cosmetic formulations from external
factors, ensuring their efficacy and quality.

## Acrylic Cosmetic Jar

Acrylic cosmetic jars provide a transparent and glossy appearance, showcasing the product within and
enhancing its visual appeal.Acrylic allows for various design options, enabling unique shapes,
sizes, and labeling to align with brand aesthetics.

## Worldwide Distribution Opportunities
* Be The First To Offer Award Winning Products In Your Country
* Join Successful International Partners In 34 Nations
* Receive FREE Comprehensive Training and Support To Insure Your Success
  
  ### [TELL ME MORE][51]

### **Be An International Retailer or Distributor Of Premium US Beauty Products**

We are looking for individuals with strong marketing and sales management skills. Go Getters.

There are a couple of ways to become a partner in this exciting venture:
1. As a **RETAILER**, you carry the products in your store. Our retailers sell between $2,700 and
   $16,000 per month. You’ll need $3,000 US for your startup inventory.

2. As an **EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTOR**, you’ll own the wholesaling business for your country. Our
distributors earn between $180,000 and $350,000 annually. You will need $6,000 for your startup
inventory. 

Whichever path you choose, you will be assigned a senior sales manager who will train you on selling
and marketing your products. And you will be provided with ongoing guidance to ensure your success
and get you up to speed quickly and profitably. 

[ Receive More Information ][52]

BRANDS WITH A BUILT IN FOLLOWING
* [Close-up of a woman with long, wavy red hair, captioned 'Color Me Beautiful'.]
  
  ## COLOR ME BEAUTIFUL
  
  Based on the #1 New York Times bestseller, this brand has lead the way in customizing color
  cosmetics for and individual's unique coloring. This approach makes choosing perfect products
  easy, it builds long term customer relationships.
* [A woman with clear skin touching her face, advertising Adrien Arpel Skin.]
  
  ## ADRIEN ARPEL SKINCARE AND SPA
  
  Formulated for the maturing woman. Supported by laboratory testing, these products deliver younger
  looking and feeling skin. Featuring fruit, vegetables and botanical extracts that are a delight to
  the senses- the Adrien Arpel line makes every day a day at the spa.
* [Portrait of a woman with dark, wavy hair and makeup, wearing a black top with a semi-sheer
  pattern. Text overlay reads 'Flori Roberts'.]
  
  ## FLORI ROBERTS COSMETICS
  
  Color cosmetics and skin care designed for women of color. Leading the way with the best quality
  products and color selections enhance the exotic beauty of the woman of color. nique and natural
  break-through products which even skin tone and brightens skin within 30 days.
* [Close-up of a woman with dark wavy hair, bold red lipstick, and red nail polish, with her hand
  touching her face]
  
  ## GALE HAYMAN BEVERLY HILLS COSMETICS
  
  Immediate anti-aging skincare as well as products developed by Gale Hayman, co-founder of the
  famous Giorgio of Beverly Hills. Award winning products. A TV retailing and makeup artist's
  favorite.

Address: 12176 Livingston Rd., Manassas, VA. 20109

## Understanding Shelf Life vs. Period After Opening (PAO)

When checking cosmetic expiration dates, it's crucial to understand the difference between shelf
life and Period After Opening (PAO). These two concepts work together to determine your product's
true expiration timeline.

### Shelf Life

**Definition:** How long a cosmetic item remains stable and effective when *unopened* and stored
under appropriate conditions.

#### Key Facts:
* Typically ranges from 2-5 years for most cosmetics
* Determined from the production date (batch code)
* Varies by product type, formulation, and brand
* Products with less than 30 months of shelf life legally require an expiration date in many
  countries

### Period After Opening (PAO)

**Definition:** How long a cosmetic remains safe and effective *after* it has been opened and
exposed to air, bacteria, and contamination.

#### Key Facts:
* Indicated by the "open jar" symbol with a number and "M" (months)
* Begins counting from the first use/opening of the product
* Generally shorter than the unopened shelf life
* More critical for products with high water content or in jar packaging

### How to Find the PAO Symbol

The Period After Opening symbol looks like an open jar with a number followed by "M" (for months).
For example, "12M" means the product should be used within 12 months after opening.

Look for this symbol:
* On the back or bottom of packaging
* Near the ingredient list
* Sometimes on the outer box only (not the product itself)

For optimal safety, you should consider **both** the cosmetic's production date (which our batch
code checker reveals) **and** how long it's been since you opened it (PAO). Whichever comes
first—the overall expiration date or the PAO timeframe—should determine when you should stop using
the cosmetic item.

2. 2 **Enter the Batch Code:** Find the batch code on your product's packaging. It's usually a short
   string of letters and numbers printed or embossed on the container.
3. 3 **Get Instant Results:** Our system analyzes the code and provides you with the manufacturing
   date, estimated shelf life, and the calculated expiration date.

Beyond just dates, COSR.AI aims to be an educational hub. We provide information on how to find
batch codes for specific brands, understand PAO (Period After Opening) symbols, and general tips for
extending the life of your cosmetics safely.

### Understanding Cosmetic Dating: Key Terms
* **Batch Code (or Lot Number):** A unique identifier assigned by manufacturers to a specific
  production run of a product. This code contains encrypted information about the manufacturing
  date.
* **Manufacturing Date (MFD):** The date when the product was made. This is the primary piece of
  information our tool decodes.
* **Shelf Life:** The period during which an unopened product, stored correctly, will remain stable,
  effective, and safe to use. This is typically 2-5 years for most cosmetics.
* **Expiration Date:** The date after which a product should not be used, even if unopened. For
  products with a shelf life under 30 months, an explicit expiration date is often printed. Our tool
  calculates an estimated expiration date based on the manufacturing date and typical shelf life.
* **Period After Opening (PAO):** Indicated by a symbol of an open jar with a number followed by "M"
  (e.g., "12M"), this tells you how long a product remains safe and effective after it has been
  opened for the first time, regardless of its original expiration date (as long as it's within that
  date).

## What is a Cosmetic Batch Code?

A batch code (sometimes called a lot number or lot code) is a unique identifier printed on your
beauty product's packaging that helps manufacturers track production data. It's a crucial piece of
information that contains encoded manufacturing details, including the production date—which is
essential for determining if your product is still safe to use.

### Where to Find Batch Codes
* Bottom of containers (common for foundation bottles, lipsticks, etc.)
* On the crimped edge of tubes (mascaras, lip glosses)
* Printed on the outer packaging box
* Near the barcode or ingredient list
* Stamped or etched directly onto glass bottles (perfumes)
* Inside the lid or cap of some products

### Common Batch Code Formats

Batch codes vary widely between brands, but generally fall into these formats:
* **Numeric Codes:** Pure numbers (e.g., 1234567)
* **Alphanumeric Codes:** Mix of letters and numbers (e.g., A42B5C)
* **Date-Based Codes:** Encoded manufacturing dates (e.g., 0324 for March 2024)
* **Complex Codes:** Combination of plant ID, production line, date, and batch sequence

Each brand uses its own encoding system, which is why our batch code checker is so valuable—it
decodes these complex systems to reveal your product's actual production date and estimated shelf
life.

## Benefits of Using cosr.ai

### Free & Accessible
* Completely free to use
* No registration required
* Instant results
* Works on all devices

### Comprehensive Coverage
* Hundreds of popular brands
* All types of beauty products
* Regular algorithm updates
* Global and regional brands

### Accurate & Reliable
* Based on manufacturer data
* Regular database updates
* Clear result explanations
* Cosmetic dating specialists

### User-Friendly
* Clean, intuitive interface
* Mobile-optimized design
* Fast loading times
* Educational resources

Our cosmetic batch code checker is especially valuable for beauty enthusiasts who buy cosmetics from
various sources, such as online retailers, duty-free shops, or during sales. It helps you make
informed decisions about your beauty collection and prioritize which cosmetic items to use first
based on their remaining shelf life.

## Understanding Shelf Life vs. Period After Opening (PAO)

When checking cosmetic expiration dates, it's crucial to understand the difference between shelf
life and Period After Opening (PAO). These two concepts work together to determine your product's
true expiration timeline.

### Shelf Life

**Definition:** How long a cosmetic item remains stable and effective when *unopened* and stored
under appropriate conditions.

#### Key Facts:
* Typically ranges from 2-5 years for most cosmetics
* Determined from the production date (batch code)
* Varies by product type, formulation, and brand
* Products with less than 30 months of shelf life legally require an expiration date in many
  countries

### Period After Opening (PAO)

**Definition:** How long a cosmetic remains safe and effective *after* it has been opened and
exposed to air, bacteria, and contamination.

#### Key Facts:
* Indicated by the "open jar" symbol with a number and "M" (months)
* Begins counting from the first use/opening of the product
* Generally shorter than the unopened shelf life
* More critical for products with high water content or in jar packaging

### How to Find the PAO Symbol

The Period After Opening symbol looks like an open jar with a number followed by "M" (for months).
For example, "12M" means the product should be used within 12 months after opening.

Look for this symbol:
* On the back or bottom of packaging
* Near the ingredient list
* Sometimes on the outer box only (not the product itself)

For optimal safety, you should consider **both** the cosmetic's production date (which our batch
code checker reveals) **and** how long it's been since you opened it (PAO). Whichever comes
first—the overall expiration date or the PAO timeframe—should determine when you should stop using
the cosmetic item.

This month, Coty brand and market leaders gathered in Paris to drive our shared priorities forward

July 14, 2026

Strong brands know exactly who they serve best. For CoverGirl, that means reconnecting with a
generation that has been central to the brand's story for decades. Gen X accounts for roughly
one-third of beauty spending and is projected to remain the world's highest-spending generation
across consumer categories through at least 2033 — a consumer group with real purchasing power and a
clear appreciation for quality, accessibility, and value. Gordon von Bretten, President of Consumer
Beauty, put it plainly in Bloomberg Businessweek: "We're going to be intentional about serving that
consumer, rather than trying to be everything to everyone." That intentionality shows up in the work
— from campaigns featuring models aged 45 to 55 to sub-$10 innovation that keeps accessibility at
the core. Serving Gen X with greater focus, while remaining a brand for all generations, is what
powers CoverGirl's next chapter of growth. Read the full story in Bloomberg Businessweek:
https://lnkd.in/emFW-HNN #CotyNews #Coty #ConsumerBeauty #CoverGirl

perspective, shaping a composition inspired by radiance, depth and determination, united in one
unforgettable olfactive signature.   A new trio. A new era. Crafted in duality: the radiance of Pink

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

## Our Story

At Fame Cosmetics, we’re passionate about being your **trusted ****custom cosmetics manufacturer**.
We specialize in private label solutions and understand that every brand has its own unique story
and needs. That’s why we create **OEM/ODM products** tailored just for you!

Our dedicated team is here to provide exceptional service and support, always looking for innovative
ways to help you succeed and grow your brand in the beauty world. Let’s work together to bring your
vision to life!

## Our advantage

Discover why we are the ideal partner for your cosmetic needs.

##### Certified Quality Assurance

Our factory is ISO 22716 and GMPC certified, ensuring international safety and quality standards—so
you can trust what you sell.

##### Customized Solutions

We create custom formulations and packaging that reflect your brand, helping your products stand
out.

##### Premium Ingredients

Our partnerships with top suppliers like BASF and Roche secure high-quality raw materials for
superior products.

##### Innovative Development

Our lab launches over 100 new formulations each year, keeping you ahead of market trends and
customer demands.

##### Expert Training and Management

With extensive team training and strict procedures, we ensure safe, efficient production and
high-quality results.

##### Global Reach

Our products are exported to the USA, Brazil, the EU, and beyond, earning a strong reputation for
quality and exceptional customer service.

At fame, we know that quality is the foundation of our business. That’s why we’re committed to
delivering high-quality products that meet our customers’ expectations, and we’re always looking for
ways to improve our quality control process to ensure that every product meets our high standards.

Each year, we attend top industry exhibitions to showcase our latest products and innovations. It’s

Fortune International provides solutions covering the whole range of cosmetics manufacturing, from
conception to completion. As seasoned cosmetics products manufacturers in India, we generate

Are you a company trying to find effective [third party cosmetic manufacturers][41] in India? We
provide efficient, adaptable services that assist both well-known and upcoming brands in launching
new goods. Reliability, openness, and demonstrated outcomes are the foundations of our standing as
top third-party cosmetic manufacturers.

### Tailored Approaches for Modern Brands

No two cosmetic lines are the same, and at Fortune International, personalized service is at the
heart of what we do. As [private label cosmetic manufacturers][42], we guide you in crafting
innovative, safe, and market-ready formulas. Clients benefit from a full suite of services provided
by our dedicated team, making us a top choice for private label cosmetic manufacturers in India. If
you want a fast and effective way to enter the market, our expertise as a white label cosmetic
manufacturer will help you launch your own range with impressive speed and precision.

Enjoy flexible solutions as we design, formulate, and package your brand’s products under strict
controls. Our proficiency with white label cosmetics ensures your next launch meets both consumer
and regulatory standards. Be confident in partnering with Fortune International; a company renowned
for its integrity and expertise.

### Our Quality Promise

Every product we manufacture shows how much we care about quality and making our customers happy. As
a well-known cosmetic products manufacturer, our standards meet and often exceed safety and
effectiveness standards set by India and the rest of the world. Our R&D labs have skilled chemists
and scientists who meticulously plan and test each batch, which shows that we are the best cosmetics
manufacturers. Fortune International makes world-class cosmetics for [skincare][43], [haircare][44],
and wellness using advanced production techniques that combine science and art.

### Full-Service, End-to-End Manufacturing

We know what it takes to make a great cosmetic brand, which is why we offer more than just making
the product; we also offer dependable packaging solutions. We make sure that your product is not
only high-quality but also looks good and lasts a long time as a cosmetic packaging manufacturers.
Because we are a holistic cosmetics manufacturer, our clients gain fresh ideas, efficiency, and
consistency at every step of the supply chain.

### Industry Achievements and Global Reach

Fortune International’s proven track record as a top cosmetic manufacturer is reflected in our
growing list of achievements. We have delivered hundreds of original formulations, expanded into new
markets, and guided start-ups and established brands through every aspect of cosmetic manufacture.
With a broad portfolio across skincare, haircare, body care, and personal wellness categories, we
are the preferred cosmetics manufacturer for partners across continents.

### Impressive Numbers that Inspire Confidence
* Over 1,000 brand collaborations worldwide
* Capacity to manufacture millions of units annually
* Trusted by leading industry names for cosmetic third party manufacturing and private label
  projects

These numbers underline our reputation as one of the most reliable cosmetics manufacturing
specialists in the industry.

### Moving Forward Together

Fortune International is ready to help you with your next project, whether you need third-party
cosmetic manufacturers in India, top [white label cosmetics manufacturers][45] in India, or a
reliable white label cosmetic manufacturer. We work with both new and established enterprises, and
we can adjust the size of the batches we make to fit your needs. We also give full consultation
throughout the process.

Use our experience as cosmetic packaging manufacturers and service-oriented partners to help you
reach your commercial goals. We are committed to delivering professionally executed, timely, and
cost-effective manufacturing for every client.

## GLAMOUR TEK AG

**GLAMOUR TEK AG is a Switzerland-based wholesale distributor specializing in perfumes and
cosmetics, committed to supplying premium beauty products to retailers around the world. With a
focus on quality, reliability, and global reach, the company delivers a diverse portfolio of trusted
beauty brands tailored to meet the evolving needs of the international retail market.**

We unite players, families, and coaches in an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued.
Through events and support for one another, we foster connections that go beyond the sport.

## Fun

Enjoying the game creates a positive environment for players to thrive. Through team activities and
outings, we foster joyful experiences that build teamwork and lasting memories.

## TeamWork

Teamwork is key to our club. We focus on collaboration and trust, helping players support each other
on and off the field. Together, we build skills and lasting friendships.

### join the global distributor

At Glamour TEK AG, we don’t just supply beauty products, we power your business with products that
sell. As a Switzerland based wholesaler, we combine premium quality, competitive pricing, and
trend-driven selections to give you a clear edge in a fast-moving market. From cosmetics and
perfumes to skincare and makeup & beauty essentials, every item in our portfolio is carefully chosen
to meet real customer demand.

What sets us apart is our commitment to reliability and results. We understand that your success
depends on consistent supply, attractive margins, and products your customers trust and love. That’s
why we focus on delivering not only quality goods but also a seamless wholesale experience you can
depend on.

Partner with Glamour TEK AG and gain more than a supplier. gain a strategic advantage. Let us help
you grow your business, attract more customers, and stay ahead of beauty trends with confidence.

###### About Us

## GLAMOUR TEK AG

**GLAMOUR TEK AG is a Switzerland-based wholesale distributor specializing in perfumes and
cosmetics, committed to supplying premium beauty products to retailers around the world. With a
focus on quality, reliability, and global reach, the company delivers a diverse portfolio of trusted
beauty brands tailored to meet the evolving needs of the international retail market.**

## Community

We unite players, families, and coaches in an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued.
Through events and support for one another, we foster connections that go beyond the sport.

## Fun

Enjoying the game creates a positive environment for players to thrive. Through team activities and
outings, we foster joyful experiences that build teamwork and lasting memories.

## TeamWork

Teamwork is key to our club. We focus on collaboration and trust, helping players support each other
on and off the field. Together, we build skills and lasting friendships.

### join the global distributor

At Glamour TEK AG, we don’t just supply beauty products, we power your business with products that
sell. As a Switzerland based wholesaler, we combine premium quality, competitive pricing, and
trend-driven selections to give you a clear edge in a fast-moving market. From cosmetics and
perfumes to skincare and makeup & beauty essentials, every item in our portfolio is carefully chosen
to meet real customer demand.

What sets us apart is our commitment to reliability and results. We understand that your success
depends on consistent supply, attractive margins, and products your customers trust and love. That’s
why we focus on delivering not only quality goods but also a seamless wholesale experience you can
depend on.

Partner with Glamour TEK AG and gain more than a supplier. gain a strategic advantage. Let us help
you grow your business, attract more customers, and stay ahead of beauty trends with confidence.

Our in house research & development, manufacturing and quality assurance is trusted by nationally
recognized brands.

Reliable skin care manufacturing is our most recognizable feature. We embody this through

health and beauty product categories.

We can help.

Contract manufacturing is for you.

[professional cosmetic manufacturing products]

Custom manufactured products from formulation through packaging in any way your brand requires.

sheet masks/cosmetic wipes, intimacy products.

Private label cutting-edge hair care & color creations to maximize your brand

[ Contact us for more informations ][23]

 

## WHY CHOOSE US

Created in **1982 **in Varese, with an expertise of more than 40 years, we are specialized in the
**production and marketing** of cutting-edge **private label cosmetics** in the hair and cosmetic
sectors, personalized for worldwide beauty brands.

 

We are more than a simple manufacturer: we fulfill your dreams producing in Italy to preserve a
l**ong-established tradition of quality and ****authenticity**, recognized by many different brands
all over the world. We are present in **90 countries on the 5 continents**. Discover how to
become one of our partners.

**5 laboratories**: R&D hair care, R&D hair color, R&D hair care, Quality control and
industrialization work effortlessly to combine new trends, ingredients, and techniques to
efficiently take care of your clientele’s hair.

**ENVIRONMENTALLY CONSCIOUS**

We have implemented a corporate sustainability policy to improve the
impact on the environment of all our activities and suppliers collaborating with us.

**STRICT QUALITY CONTROL**

When it comes to the quality and safety of our private label beauty
products, we have a zero-tolerance policy. We put meticulous attention
to make sure that all the cosmetic products respect the international laws and the standards

Our internal regulatory affairs division ensures full compliance with
regulations, laws, and legislation on an international level, making sure
that the distribution of our private label cosmetics is performed correctlyin more than 90
countries.

Founded in 1982 by the Zanzi family with the aim of developing important expertise in hair color,
today H.S.A. has extended its business to care products for hair, face and body, becoming the ideal
marketing partner for companies that desire an innovative 360° approach to beauty.

 

The acquisition by Tec Beauty SpA – The Equity Club in 2021, a private investment company, is
accelerating growth at a global level thanks to
the creation of a unique beauty group in Italy, made up of industrial excellences in hair care, skin

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## katie stapleton | AIA, leed ap

Katie Stapleton has 20 years of professional experience in programming, designing and managing the
build out of high-end corporate interiors, institutional and residential projects. During her time
on the end-user side for two Fortune 500 companies, she has partnered with outside design firms to
develop and implement various workplace strategies, focusing on strategic occupancy planning, agile
[or activity based] working, and change management.

She has worked on all phases of a project, as both the architect and the owner, including lease
review, program development, test-fit layouts, budget and schedule development, contract documents,
furniture selection and procurement, construction management, move management, and post-occupancy
services. She is also knowledgeable in building information modeling and sustainable design
practices, and has integrated them on a multitude of projects.

She has also been involved with the Architectural League as a freelance writer and research
associate for their Urban Omnibus site, exploring areas of architectural interest in New York City.

Katie holds a Bachelor of Architecture from Penn State University and has been a licensed Architect
in the State of New York since 2011.

Luxury Beauty Wholesale gives approved businesses access to premium beauty wholesale across
skincare, cosmetics, fragrance, haircare, bath and body, and fast-moving beauty stock. Built for
retailers, e-commerce sellers, pharmacies, salons, and distributors, our membership-based platform
connects buyers to a curated global supply network with speed, confidence, and control. For
businesses looking for a reliable beauty wholesaler in the UK, LBW offers more than product access.
We help members secure authentic stock, streamline sourcing, and buy with greater confidence across

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Here are the top questions our clients ask before getting started.

What types of products do you source?

We specialize in natural food ingredients, oils, butters, botanical extracts, and cosmetic-grade raw
materials from across Latin America. Our portfolio includes staples like avocado oil, cocoa
derivatives, coffee extracts, herbal botanicals, and animal-derived ingredients such as beef tallow
(food and cosmetic grade).

Do you offer both food- and cosmetic-grade ingredients?

Yes. Many of our raw materials, such as oils and butters, are processed under dual certification
streams—one suitable for food applications and another refined for cosmetic or pharmaceutical use.
We ensure each product complies with the relevant safety and purity standards.

What certifications do your producers carry?

Depending on the ingredient and supplier, we provide: • Organic certification (USDA, EU, or local
equivalents) • Fair Trade & sustainability certifications • ISO & GMP manufacturing standards •
Rainforest or GlobalGap certification, where applicable All certifications are available upon
request.

Do you supply in bulk or small batches?

We primarily serve B2B customers with bulk volumes (drums, totes, containers), but we also arrange
smaller test batches or samples for R&D and product development teams.

What are your minimum order quantities (MOQs)?

MOQs vary by product: • Oils and butters: typically 25–200 kg • Botanical extracts: 5–25 kg • Bulk
commodities (e.g., tallow, avocado oil): container-loads (16–20 metric tons)

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ##### Frequently Asked Questions

Q. What cosmetic manufacturing services does Reviera Overseas offer?
A. We offer private label, OEM/ODM, third-party manufacturing, formulation, and packaging services
for skincare and personal care products.
Q. Do you manufacture private label skincare and haircare products?
A. Yes, we specialize in custom skincare and haircare products for private label brands in India and
abroad.
Q. Can I launch my own cosmetic brand with you?
A. Absolutely. We help you build your brand from scratch with formulation, design, and manufacturing
support.
Q. What types of beauty products do you make?
A. We manufacture creams, serums, face washes, facial kits, tan removers, SPF, gels, and more.
Q. Are your cosmetic products certified?
A. Yes, we are GMP certified and ISO 9001:2008 compliant to ensure high product quality and safety.
Q. Do you create herbal or Ayurvedic cosmetic products?
A. Yes, we offer natural, herbal, and Ayurvedic cosmetic formulations for private labels.
Q. Can you design packaging and labels for my brand?
A. Yes, we provide custom label design and packaging solutions to match your brand identity.
Q. What is the MOQ for cosmetic manufacturing?
A. Our minimum order quantity varies by product. Contact us for detailed MOQ info.
Q. Do you work with dermatologists and clinics?
A. Yes, we manufacture dermatologically tested skincare products for clinics and professionals.
Q. Can I export cosmetic products made by you?
A. Yes, we manufacture export-quality cosmetics meeting international standards.
Q. How long does it take to manufacture a product?
A. Turnaround time depends on your product and order size, but we aim for fast and efficient
delivery.
Q. How can I get a quote or start an order?
A. Simply fill out the enquiry form or contact us at +91 90990 13176 or info@revieraoverseas.com.

## Your K-Beauty OEM ODM Cosmetic Manufacturing Services Provider

Sourcing-lab builds a bridge between global beauty brands, Korea’s latest innovations, and
trendsetting beauty technology.

Whether you are building your new brand or extending your current line, Sourcing-lab is a turnkey

## Korean Cosmetic Innovations from Seoul

Based in Seoul with a dynamic, international team, Sourcing-lab thrives to be on the front end of
helping in your manufacturing of beauty products. We are launching state-of-the-art products with a
strong focus on quality and aesthetics, pioneering in making the Beauty world a kinder place.

### Formulations, Regulatory Compliance, Branding & Design, Packaging, R&D, Manufacturing

## From Idea to Launch in One-stop Manufacturing Solution

## branding

Complete brand development service starting with concept and story. A good brand concept is
essential, as it creates the theme and synergy, which hold the products together as a family.

## FORMULATION

Developing a unique ODM formulation in accordance with the Brand Concept includes determining the
ingredients, achieving the desired texture, color, aroma, and efficacy.

## PACKAGING

Sourcing the packaging that immediately holds the skincare solution. We ensure that the packaging is
both appealing to the target consumer, while retaining maximum functionality, safety, durability,
and all within your budget.

## DESIGN

Our goal is to create a product line with a consistent appearance on the shelf or online, so that
any product can be immediately recognize as part of the brand. In this step, we also address
secondary text to meet functional goals, marketing needs, and regulatory requirements.

## MANUFACTURING

Sourcing-lab seeks to award production contracts and partnerships to Enterprises, Groups, SMEs, and
Entrepreneurs, whenever possible. This allows us to support the founders of the Korean cosmetic
industry, and the innovators who fuel it’s global leadership.

## REGULATORY

Sourcing-lab provides a set of documentation for import / regulatory approval. We support major
requirements worldwide, including cruelty-free, organic, vegan, COSMOS standard, sustainability, or
ECOCERT compliant.

## Korean Cosmetic Innovations from Seoul

Based in Seoul with a dynamic, international team, Sourcing-lab thrives to be on the front end of
helping in your manufacturing of beauty products. We are launching state-of-the-art products with a
strong focus on quality and aesthetics, pioneering in making the Beauty world a kinder place.

### Formulations, Regulatory Compliance, Branding & Design, Packaging, R&D, Manufacturing

## From Idea to Launch in One-stop Manufacturing Solution

## branding

Complete brand development service starting with concept and story. A good brand concept is
essential, as it creates the theme and synergy, which hold the products together as a family.

## FORMULATION

Developing a unique ODM formulation in accordance with the Brand Concept includes determining the
ingredients, achieving the desired texture, color, aroma, and efficacy.

## PACKAGING

Sourcing the packaging that immediately holds the skincare solution. We ensure that the packaging is
both appealing to the target consumer, while retaining maximum functionality, safety, durability,
and all within your budget.

## DESIGN

Our goal is to create a product line with a consistent appearance on the shelf or online, so that
any product can be immediately recognize as part of the brand. In this step, we also address
secondary text to meet functional goals, marketing needs, and regulatory requirements.

## MANUFACTURING

Sourcing-lab seeks to award production contracts and partnerships to Enterprises, Groups, SMEs, and
Entrepreneurs, whenever possible. This allows us to support the founders of the Korean cosmetic
industry, and the innovators who fuel it’s global leadership.

Sourcing-lab provides a set of documentation for import / regulatory approval. We support major
requirements worldwide, including cruelty-free, organic, vegan, COSMOS standard, sustainability, or

## Quick Answers, Clear Solutions.

1. How fast can I get samples?

Standard formulas can be completed in 3–10 working days, allowing most clients to move from idea to
evaluation very quickly.
For fully custom formulas, our R&D team delivers samples within 10–20 working days, depending on raw
material availability and testing needs.
This speed is possible because all formulation, testing and adjustments are done in-house by our
senior engineers.

2. What is your production lead time?
Once all packaging and raw materials are ready and the deposit is received, bulk production
typically takes 20–45 days.
This includes pilot testing, mass production, filling, quality inspection and packing.
Our 38 automated production lines and high-capacity factory enable consistent, predictable on-time
delivery even during peak seasons.
3. Do you offer custom formulas and packaging?
Yes. TOYOLY provides full OEM/ODM customization, including formula development, safety and stability
testing, packaging design, structural engineering, and packaging material sourcing.
We design both the product formulation and the outer packaging to match your brand identity,
performance goals and market positioning.
This one-stop approach keeps timelines short and ensures high compatibility between formula and
packaging.
4. What is your MOQ?

For fully custom formulas, the standard MOQ is 5,000–10,000 units, which ensures consistent quality
across batches.

For market testing or first-time launches, we offer flexible test MOQs of 1,000–3,000 pcs per color,
making it easier for emerging or e-commerce brands to validate products with low risk.
This flexibility is part of our “fast-launch” support system.
5. Are you a certified factory?

Yes. TOYOLY operates a 65,000㎡ facility certified by ISO22716, GMPC, FDA and HALAL, ensuring
global-standard production quality.
Our factory includes 38 automated production lines and advanced emulsification, filling, testing and
purification equipment.
This certification system ensures stable quality and reduces risks that could delay timelines.

6. Can you assist with product filing or regulatory compliance?

Yes. Our compliance team can assist with global regulatory preparation, including formula compliance
checks, ingredient restrictions, safety assessments and filing/registration (CPNP, FDA, etc.).
We evaluate compliance at the start of formulation development to avoid rework and ensure smooth
market entry for your target region.

7. Do you support small brands or first-time beauty entrepreneurs?

Absolutely. We offer flexible MOQs, fast sampling and full-chain support, making TOYOLY ideal for
new brands, indie founders and e-commerce creators.
Our team helps with product planning, packaging recommendations and efficient production planning so
new brands can launch smoothly and scale confidently.

8. Can you produce both color cosmetics and skincare?

Yes. We are a full-category beauty manufacturer covering color cosmetics, skincare and hair/body
care, with deep experience across all product types.
Our R&D team handles multiple formula systems—from emulsions to powders—ensuring product consistency
across categories for brands that want integrated lines.

9. Do you provide packaging sourcing or can I use my own supplier?

We can do both. TOYOLY has in-house packaging factories capable of producing plastic cases, tubes
and custom-mold components, ensuring faster timelines and better quality control.
At the same time, we can coordinate with your existing suppliers and perform quality inspections on
incoming materials to ensure compatibility and stability.

10. Do you support international shipping?

Yes. We support FOB, CIF and DDP shipping terms and arrange global transportation via air or sea.
Air freight typically takes 5–10 days, while sea freight to North America or Europe is usually 30–45
days.
We also provide packing lists, MSDS-compliant packaging and full tracking information for smooth
customs clearance.

checks, ingredient restrictions, safety assessments and filing/registration (CPNP, FDA, etc.).

new brands, indie founders and e-commerce creators.

new brands can launch smoothly and scale confidently.

care, with deep experience across all product types.

across categories for brands that want integrated lines.

and custom-mold components, ensuring faster timelines and better quality control.

incoming materials to ensure compatibility and stability.

Air freight typically takes 5–10 days, while sea freight to North America or Europe is usually 30–45
days.

customs clearance.

# Supply Chain Integration & Collaboration Software

##### PreBuilt Automated Integrations with ERP Systems, 3PL Warehouses, Suppliers, Customers &
##### Logistics Partners

##### Maximizing Supply Chain Efficiency:  360° Visibility by Integration

##### Do not try to re-invent the wheel - Let us hep to connect the dots in your Supply Chain with
##### our decades of integration expertise.

## "Unlock Success: Elevate Your Supply Chain Collaboration with TPSynergy"

In the modern business landscape, supply chain collaboration is not just a strategy; it's a
necessity. TPSynergy offers cutting-edge solutions to boost your supply chain collaboration,

Manufacturing models

## Three ways to make your product

### Private label

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

[Browse private label manufacturers ][42]

### White label

You select an existing product the manufacturer already produces and apply your branding. Use it
when speed and low MOQs matter more than uniqueness. The formula stays with the manufacturer and may
be sold to other brands in parallel, so you carry less development risk but accept that competitors
may shelve a near-identical product.

[Browse white label manufacturers ][43]

### Contract manufacturing

You hand the manufacturer a complete specification or formula and they produce it to order. Use it
when you have proprietary IP, regulated processes, or volumes that justify dedicated production. You
own the formula, the manufacturer owns the capacity, and the commercial terms are usually structured
around guaranteed minimum runs.

Manufacturing models

## Three ways to make your product

### Private label

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

[Browse private label manufacturers ][42]

### White label

You select an existing product the manufacturer already produces and apply your branding. Use it
when speed and low MOQs matter more than uniqueness. The formula stays with the manufacturer and may
be sold to other brands in parallel, so you carry less development risk but accept that competitors
may shelve a near-identical product.

[Browse white label manufacturers ][43]

### Contract manufacturing

You hand the manufacturer a complete specification or formula and they produce it to order. Use it
when you have proprietary IP, regulated processes, or volumes that justify dedicated production. You
own the formula, the manufacturer owns the capacity, and the commercial terms are usually structured
around guaranteed minimum runs.

Core Capabilities

## End-to-End Manufacturing Solutions

From concept to shelf, our integrated production capabilities ensure every product meets the highest
standards of performance, safety, and aesthetic appeal.

💉

### Injection Molding

High-precision injection molding for cosmetic caps, closures, compacts, and structural packaging
components with tight tolerances and consistent quality.

🫧

### Bottle Blowing

Advanced PET and PE bottle blowing technology producing crystal-clear, lightweight, and durable
containers for serums, lotions, and liquid cosmetics.

🖨️

### Silk-Screen Printing

Automated and manual silk-screen printing delivering sharp, vibrant branding on glass, plastic, and
metal cosmetic packaging with exceptional color accuracy.

🔧

### Assembly & Filling

Streamlined assembly lines for multi-component cosmetic products, from powder compacts to lipsticks,
mascara, and complex skincare packaging systems.

🔍

### Quality Control

Multi-stage quality inspection protocols covering incoming materials, in-process checks, and final
product testing to ensure zero-defect delivery.

📦

### Warehousing & Logistics

Spacious warehousing infrastructure with organized inventory management and reliable logistics
support for timely global delivery to 80+ countries.
